content:
I am happy to announce the first milestone in our project to formalize classifications of Lie algebras: the classification of solvable Lie algebras of dimension up to 3 over arbitrary fields. See our preprint: arXiv:2505.19975

We, that are Viviana del Barco, Gustavo Infanti, and me from Unicamp, and Exequiel Rivas from TalTech.

The github project is available here.

It includes in addition the formalization of some results/constructions in linear algebra and Lie algebras, for example the semidirect product of Lie algebras. Our next goal is to integrate some of these results into mathlib, and then eventually tackle the three-dimensional simple case (which is a bit wild over arbitrary fields) or higher-dimensional solvable Lie algebras.
